facts.text: Twin Falls was founded in 1904 as a planned community designed by architect Emmanuel Louis Masqueray, with townsite sales funding irrigation canals.
Perrine founded the Twin Falls Land and Water Company to build the irrigation canal system that turned the valley into a thriving agricultural hub.
The city’s name comes from the nearby waterfall on the Snake River that gave Twin Falls its nickname, the Magic Valley.
Every year, the Twin Falls Historic Preservation Commission hosts a community event to celebrate and protect the city’s historic character.
Twin Falls is the largest city within a 100‑mile radius, serving as the commercial center for south‑central Idaho and northeastern Nevada.
